answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. A wander of per-task receipts records who did what, and the marble of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The atlas of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
